IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_HelpEm: Bring milk to the steam (85 C) in a Hearth's copper and pour it in, up to 5 L, from a Hearth within 2 tiles or carried in a Wrapped Yoghurt Pot, and add a yoghurt or a starter. Once it has cooled to 45 C the incubator is wrapped and the milk sets by itself.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Starte: Starter in: the incubator is wrapped once the milk is down to 45 C.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NoStar: No starter yet. Add one before the milk drops below 40 C.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NextTo: Too cold for a starter in about %1
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NeverS: Too cold here: it won't set while the temperature holds.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NoChan: Nothing changes while the temperature holds.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Jars: Fills %1 jars, a litre each, or %2 Empty Yoghurt Containers.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_HasSta: This batch already has its starter.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_TooCol: Too cold: reheat the milk. Pour it out into a cooking pot and back into a Hearth's copper, or top it up with milk steaming from the Hearth.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Wrappe: The incubator is wrapped and setting. Leave it be.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NoStar: You need a yoghurt or an Active Yoghurt Starter that hasn't gone off.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Starte: One per batch. It can go in before the milk or while it cools.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NoCont: You need an empty pot or other fluid container.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NoJar: You need an empty Clay Jar or glass jar.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_CrockH: Load 20 wheat grains and half a litre of warm milk (35 C or more) from a Hearth's copper within 2 tiles. The grain cultures best at 25 to 35 C: keep it by the fire in winter.
The culture has taken. Feed it half a litre of fresh milk, warm or cold, and it develops into starter.
Two Active Yoghurt Starters. Each sets one batch in the Yoghurt Incubator. Use them within a few days.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_CrockS: Too cold here: the culture has stopped. Move it somewhere warmer.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NextWa: Ready for fresh milk in about %1
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_CrockN: You need half a litre of cow's or sheep's milk in one container.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_LoadHe: Takes 20 wheat grains and half a litre of the copper's milk.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_InfoSe: wrapped at %1 C, starter above %2 C
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_InfoAs: Times assume the temperature here holds.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NoEmpt: You need an Empty Yoghurt Container. Every yoghurt you eat leaves one.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_CrockM: The milk in the copper is too cold: 35 C or more. Light the Hearth and let it warm.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NoHear: No Hearth within 2 tiles. Build one (Pottery) and bring the milk to the steam in its copper.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Copper: The copper holds no cow's or sheep's milk.
The milk in the copper is at %1 C: it must steam (85 C). Keep the fire lit.
The copper holds less than half a litre of milk.
The copper holds %1: fluids don't mix. Empty it first.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NotOne: A mix of fluids: only one plain fluid goes into the copper.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NoFlui: You have nothing with a fluid in it.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NoRoom: You have no empty container, nor one holding the same fluid with room.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Hearth: Pour milk into the copper and light the fire. At 85 C it steams, and it pours into a Yoghurt Incubator within 2 tiles.
The fire is out: the copper cools. Add fuel and light it.
Only milk pours into an incubator or a crock. Fill your own containers from it.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NotSte: Not steamed: only milk drawn from a Hearth's copper at 85 C or more goes in.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_PotMix: The incubator holds %1: milks don't mix.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_NoMilk: You have no container of milk.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Steame: Milk drawn steaming from a Hearth's copper, in any container. It goes in at the heat it has now: only a Wrapped Yoghurt Pot keeps it hot on the way.
